summary: Compared the product-overview source facts and exact 1920 px reference/render/diff crop. The wrapper geometry passes (2 px x/width and 1 px y deltas), but section pixel difference is 16.3248%, above the 8.5% page-owner acceptance, and multiple prominent native-commerce elements are visibly wrong or absent.
issues: VIS-PRODUCT-OVERVIEW-001 | priority: critical | property: variation price presentation | expected: selected 5 L state shows Cena: 411,00 zł, struck-through 530,00 zł, (w tym 23% VAT), and the 30-day-low disclosure | actual: a generic 82,20 zł – 1.644,00 zł range is shown and all comparison/tax/lowest-price content is missing | fix: render the selected native 5 L variation price and all source-backed price annotations.

VIS-PRODUCT-OVERVIEW-002 | priority: critical | property: purchasable controls | expected: outlined quantity stepper, green cart button with cart icon, and visible 1 L/5 L/20 L buttons with 5 L selected | actual: quantity stepper and size buttons are absent, a malformed Pojemność/Wybierz opcję label appears, and the cart button is a small disabled-looking purple control | fix: expose the real WooCommerce variation buttons, quantity control and enabled selected-variation add-to-cart state with source styling.

VIS-PRODUCT-OVERVIEW-003 | priority: high | property: source text rendering | expected: Kod produktu: 98899 and Producent: Rudnikagro as clean two-line metadata | actual: literal markup text 98899
is visible | fix: render semantic markup instead of escaped HTML text.

VIS-PRODUCT-OVERVIEW-004 | priority: high | property: secondary controls/content | expected: full-width orange Zamienniki accordion followed by divider, 4/5 rating, wholesale-contact row with mail icon, and favourites row with heart icon | actual: accordion/rating/favourite row are missing and the wholesale text is incorrectly styled as the orange pill | fix: restore all sourced rows/icons and align their order, dimensions, borders and colors to the reference.

VIS-PRODUCT-OVERVIEW-005 | priority: high | property: typography | expected: bold 48 px-scale Aquatos 5L heading and source-aligned product information hierarchy | actual: thin smaller heading and compressed/misaligned text hierarchy | fix: match source font size, weight, line heights and vertical spacing after restoring missing controls.
